question: Should Plantago afra be recommended for: treatment of habitual constipation and conditions where easy defaecation with soft stools is desirable?

records.notes: EU herbal monograph on psyllium seed (Plantago afra/indica) grants well-established-use status as a bulk-forming laxative for habitual constipation and conditions such as anal fissures and haemorrhoids where soft stools are desirable, per Ph. Eur. 01/2005:0858.
records.source_title: Community herbal monograph on psyllium seed, Plantago afra et Plantago indica, semen
records.target_indication: treatment of habitual constipation and conditions where easy defaecation with soft stools is desirable
records.primary_outcome: treatment of habitual constipation and conditions where easy defaecation with soft stools is desirable
